products.title: Breezy Buddy — Cat Food Cooler
products.body:
Meet your mealtime sidekick. This adorable cat hangs on the rim of a mug or bowl and gently blows so kids (and parents) don't have to.

  • Cools hot drinks & food in ~3 minutes
  • Clips onto cups & bowls (≈2–6 mm rim)
  • USB rechargeable · quiet fan
  • Food-safe outer shell · easy to wipe clean
  • Perfect kids gift · cartoon character vibe

products.title: Breezy Buddy — Frog Food Cooler
products.body:
A cheeky frog that blows the heat away. Clip it on noodles, soup, or cocoa — sip-safe fun for little ones.

  • USB rechargeable mini blower
  • Hangs on cups & bowls
  • Quiet · kid-friendly cartoon design
  • Great for hot drinks, noodles & meals

products.title: Breezy Buddy — Elephant & Dino Cooler
products.body:
Pick elephant or dino — 3-speed adjustable food cooler that hangs on the cup so mealtime stays fun and burn-free.

  • 3 speeds · low noise
  • Hands-free cup hanging design
  • Safe materials for family tables
  • Ideal for kids who hate waiting on hot food

products.title: Breezy Buddy — Animal Cooler (Assorted)
products.body:
Cute animal mini fans that hang on the cup and blow cool air over hot water, tea, rice, coffee & dishes.

  • Portable hanging cup ornament blower
  • USB powered cooling
  • Collect the whole crew

products.title: Breezy Buddy — Baby Meal Cooler Fan
products.body:
Parents' hack: cool baby meals faster without blowing yourself. 3-speed cup-hanging cartoon cooler, rechargeable & quiet.

  • 3-speed adjustable
  • Cup hanging · portable
  • Low noise for calm mealtimes
